# University of Alabama at Birmingham

> UAB is a premier research university and academic medical center offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs across multiple colleges and schools.

The University of Alabama at Birmingham (UAB) serves as a comprehensive institution combining academic excellence with a health sciences focus, featuring renowned schools including medicine, nursing, dentistry, and optometry. The website provides essential resources for prospective students, current students, faculty, staff, and alumni.

## Key Topics

- Admissions
- Financial Aid & Tuition
- Academic Programs
- Student Resources
- BlazerNET Authentication
- Heersink School of Medicine
- School of Nursing
- UAB Medicine
- Graduate Programs
- Alumni Community
- Faculty Support
- Academic Advising
- Student Success
- One Stop Services
- Scholarships & Awards

## Admissions & Enrollment

- [Admissions Overview](https://www.uab.edu/home/admissions): UAB admissions overview for undergraduate, graduate, and professional schools
- [Find Your Degree](https://www.uab.edu/degrees): Degree finder and program directory across UAB schools and colleges
- [Cost & Financial Aid](https://www.uab.edu/cost-aid): Financial aid, tuition, scholarships, and loans information for UAB students
- [Campus Visits](https://www.uab.edu/admissions/visit): Campus tours, visit planning, and preview days for prospective students

## Student Services & Support

- [One Stop Student Services](https://www.uab.edu/one-stop): One Stop Student Services for registration, financial aid, and transcripts
- [Academic Advising](https://www.uab.edu/students/academics/advising): Academic advising, degree planning, and course selection resources
- [Student Resources & Support](https://www.uab.edu/studentaffairs/families/resources): Student resources, tutoring, disability services, and family engagement

## Academics & Research

- [Academics at UAB](https://www.uab.edu/home/academics-at-uab): UAB academics overview: degree programs, colleges, schools, and research
- [Office of the Provost](https://www.uab.edu/provost): Office of Provost: strategic initiatives, curriculum, and student success

## Faculty & Staff Resources

- [Faculty Portal](https://www.uab.edu/faculty): Faculty portal with resources, governance, and teaching tools
- [Human Resources](https://www.uab.edu/humanresources/home): HR resources: employee onboarding, benefits, and leave management

## Alumni & Community

- [UAB National Alumni Society](https://alumni.uab.edu/s/1881/alumni19/home.aspx): UAB alumni community, events, networking, and engagement opportunities
- [Alumni Programs & Initiatives](https://alumni.uab.edu/s/1881/alumni19/interior.aspx): UAB alumni travel programs, awards, and community service initiatives

## System Access

- [BlazerNET Central Authentication](https://www.uab.edu/blazernet): BlazerID authentication system for UAB account access and login

## Optional
